### PROPOSAL-23 — Datamosh - **slug**: `datamosh` - **Vibe**: Corrupted video compression — macroblocks smeared across the frame, RGB channels slipping out of register, and beautiful accidents where motion vectors bleed. - **Best for**: Launch moments and the creator feed — glitch-art energy for surfaces that should feel alive and unstable. Adjectives: chaotic, vivid, generative. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#07040c` | Corrupted frame black-violet | | `--bg-surface` | `#120a1e` | Panel fill with block smear | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#1c1130` | Raised panels, smeared rows | | `--border-subtle` | `#2a1a4a` | Macroblock hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#3f2870` | Standard borders | | `--border-focus` | `#00ffd5` | Chromatic focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#f2ecff` | Clean-signal white headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#c4b2e8` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#7a68a8` | Compression-noise dim text | | `--color-action` | `#ff2b8f` | Channel-slip magenta action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#e21d7a` | Action hover (deeper magenta) | | `--color-earnings` | `#ffe14e` | Blocked-yellow earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#e6c933` | Earnings hover (deeper yellow) | | `--color-automation` | `#00ffd5` | Teal channel automation | | `--color-alert` | `#ff9d2b` | Bitrate-collapse amber | | `--color-danger` | `#ff3d5c` | Stream-failure red | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(255, 43, 143, 0.22)` | Magenta channel bleed | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(255, 225, 78, 0.18)` | Yellow block bleed | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(0, 255, 213, 0.18)` | Teal channel bleed | - **Typography**: Clean type against dirty backgrounds — the contrast is the point. Display: `"Space Grotesk", "Rajdhani", sans-serif` at 600-700, occasionally RGB-split (1px red + 1px cyan text-shadow). Body: `"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"JetBrains Mono", monospace` for corruption artifacts and hex IDs. KPIs `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Sharp 4px radius. 1px borders; some borders "break" — a CSS mask or gradient makes 10-20% of a border's length vanish or smear, like a corrupted edge. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Flat saturated fills with dark text; on hover the RGB channels split (text-shadow shifts ±1px red/cyan) and a few horizontal slice-clips flicker. Focus = 2px `--border-focus` outline. - **Cards**: Panels with a subtle macroblock smear (CSS: layered linear-gradients forming offset translucent rectangles at low opacity). One corner may carry a displaced "ghost" copy of the border. - **Badges/Status**: Chips with occasional character substitution on hover (`PUBLISHED` -> `PUBL1SH3D`); status dot is a small square that occasionally displaces 2px sideways (block shift). - **Tables**: Rows separated by 1px rules; every Nth row (deterministic, e.g. `:nth-child(9n)`) gets a smear overlay or slight horizontal displacement. Numbers stay clean — corruption is decoration, never data. - **Forms/Inputs**: Clean fields with 1px borders; the focus ring does a quick RGB-split (2-frame flash). Error text arrives glitched-in then settles. - **Loading**: A datamosh preloader: macroblocks of the previous content smear and reassemble; indeterminate = slices of color sliding horizontally at different speeds. - **Signature detail**: The channel slip — RGB-split text and smear-blocks on an otherwise clean, readable UI. Corruption decorates; it never destroys legibility. - **Motion & Animation**: Glitch cadence: mostly still, then a 150-250ms burst (translateX ±2px, clip-path slices, channel split) every 4-8s or on hover. Turbo Stream inserts arrive mid-glitch and resolve clean. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS / 30d $12,480.50
